QuestInfo.name: [NLC] Shadow Behind the Earthquake
QuestInfo.0: Professor Foxwit says he'll tell you all about what he's discovered during his research. Meet up with him to learn more.
QuestInfo.1: Professor Foxwit says the jungle invaders are aliens, and that they're excavating in search of the 'Pillar of the World.' He tells you to meet up with Glimmer Man, the self-proclaimed 'universe's greatest hitman', to stop them before their meddling causes Masteria to plunge back beneath the sea. Find Glimmer Man and secure his assistance.
QuestInfo.2: Thanks to Professor Foxwit's connections, you met the enigmatic Glimmer Man.

npc.0: Our mayor, who's got money to burn, hired the so-called 'universe's greatest hitman', a fellow known only as Glimmer Man. He calls himself the 'Great Magician'. If you tell him what you need, I think he'll be able to help you accomplish it.
